g.text: One share, two operating systems, one protocol — and one port that decides whether it works
1 · Two shares, mounted by both OSes
Both shares live in prodskycraftswcsa. Soft delete 14 days is on, snapshots are taken by hand.
A quota is a ceiling, not a reservation — you pay for what is stored, not for the quota.
2 · Port 445 is where this lab usually fails
from an Azure VM in the same region works — traffic never leaves the backbone
from your laptop over the internet usually blocked by the ISP or corporate firewall
the fix private endpoint, VPN, or just mount from a VM
